data.one_liner: Upload, download, and manage files on Microsoft OneDrive from a Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Connects to Microsoft OneDrive via OAuth authentication to perform file operations such as uploading, downloading, listing files, creating directories, and deleting items.
use_when: You need to sync or backup user application files to their OneDrive account.
Your app interacts directly with OneDrive using custom OAuth client credentials.
avoid_when: You require a general-purpose local storage database rather than cloud storage.
You need support for cloud storage providers other than OneDrive.
strengths: Provides a straightforward API for common file operations (upload, download, list, delete, create directory).
Handles authentication flow via OAuth with secure token storage.
weaknesses: Requires manual app registration and configuration with Microsoft Azure/OneDrive developer portal.
Limited to a single cloud provider.
data.setup_notes: Requires registering an app on the Microsoft developer portal to obtain a client ID and configuring redirect URLs.
